name: MahouSho*
source:
Dreams of being a princess. 
Magical girls are the embodiment of hopes and dreams. 
Read an essay combining all these topics and more.

[From [url=https://eerieemi.itch.io/mahousho]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
想當公主的夢。
魔法少女是希望與夢想的化身。
讀一讀這篇隨筆吧，它把這些話題以及更多的思緒寫在了一起。

［取自[url=https://eerieemi.itch.io/mahousho]itch.io[/url]］
